summary_en: Marumae authorized acquisition of up to 230,000 shares (0.81% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥300 million from November 11-20, 2026, to improve capital efficiency as part of flexible capital management.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Marumae's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied to the articles of incorporation under Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 230,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.81% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥300 million. The acquisition period runs from November 11 through November 20, 2026.

The company stated that the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency as part of flexible capital management. At the date of the announcement, the company held 28,367,675 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) and 55,525 treasury shares.
